note: Demo portfolio. 10 US large caps, diversified across sectors, with a deliberate semiconductor/AI-hardware cluster (AAPL / NVDA / AVGO / MSFT) so a single supply-chain event can propagate through several holdings. value_usd == qty * price_usd exactly; weight_pct sums to 100.00.

positions.name: Apple Inc.
positions.notes: Buys leading-edge silicon from TSMC; RF/connectivity content from AVGO. Exposed to Asia hardware supply chain.

positions.name: NVIDIA Corporation
positions.notes: Fabless; 100% dependent on TSMC leading-edge and CoWoS advanced packaging. Sells to MSFT and other hyperscalers.

positions.name: Microsoft Corporation
positions.notes: Largest buyer of NVDA accelerators; Azure AI capacity build-out is gated by GPU supply and by grid power.

positions.name: Broadcom Inc.
positions.notes: Custom AI ASICs and AI networking silicon, also fabbed at TSMC; significant Apple revenue concentration.

positions.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
positions.notes: Rate-sensitive: net interest income benefits from higher-for-longer policy rates.

positions.name: Exxon Mobil Corporation
positions.notes: Integrated oil and gas; direct leverage to crude prices, low correlation to the tech cluster.

positions.name: Walmart Inc.
positions.notes: Defensive; imports consumer electronics and general merchandise, so tariffs and freight costs matter.

positions.name: Johnson & Johnson
positions.notes: Defensive ballast; typically a risk-off beneficiary, minimal tech supply-chain exposure.

positions.name: Caterpillar Inc.
positions.notes: Cyclical; data-centre power generation (gensets, turbines) is a growing AI-linked revenue stream.

positions.name: NextEra Energy, Inc.
positions.notes: Regulated utility plus renewables; long-duration, rate-sensitive, and levered to data-centre load growth.
